summary: Expanded the US-listed universe around the optical interconnect compound-semiconductor stack. The strongest direct exposures found in this pass are InP substrates, datacom lasers/components, and optical module manufacturing. The list intentionally mixes reference leaders with underfollowed or less-obvious names.
